purpose: Test maximal-legal-sector plus witness partitions for every selected feasible anchor on the closest saved U2 development underfill.

input.single_source_derivation: Exact candidate_sources[6] from the immutable development freeze.

candidate_contract.trigger: Saved topology-passing area underfill on selected multi-anchor interfaces.
candidate_contract.choice_rule: For every original selected, freshly nuclei-feasible and legally partitionable anchor, create the largest connected sector allowed by the unchanged 0.75 fraction and a connected minimum-size witness.

failure_policy: Any mismatch, timeout, exception, incomplete receipt, or source identity failure is HOLD with no retry.
authorization_basis: Codex self-authorized one development counterexample because the balanced all-anchor probe preserved topology but remained 1,846 pixels below the floor, while the already validated maximal-sector representation addresses the same count-to-area quantization without changing the front contract.
